releaseNotes: Implement tracking functionality with service management and notifications
changelog: Added TrackingController for managing tracking services, including start, stop, and refresh actions.
Introduced TrackedServer data class and codec for encoding/decoding tracked server information.
Created TrackingNotificationBuilder for building and sending notifications related to tracking status.
Implemented tracking logic including memory usage calculations, polling intervals, and auto-stop conditions.
Added unit tests for tracking logic, ensuring correct behavior of encoding, decoding, and action availability.
